summary: Completed frontend testing of two parallel features: 1) Skeleton shimmer UI components for improved perceived performance 2) Payment Methods admin CRUD interface. All features working correctly.

payment_methods_page: Page /payment-methods accessible only to admin users
Non-admin users (pharmacien) correctly redirected to dashboard
Payment Methods link hidden from sidebar for non-admin users
List displays all 5 existing payment methods (cash, orange_money, card, check, mtn_money)
Each row shows: order, icon with color, name, code, required fields, status, actions
Creation form includes: code, name, icon selector, color selector, display order, active switch
Real-time preview updates as form is filled
Required fields section with add field form
Add field form includes: technical name, label, type, placeholder, maxLength, required toggle
Added fields appear in list with up/down arrows and remove button
Edit button opens form pre-filled with existing data
Edit dialog title shows 'Modifier le mode de paiement'
Delete button shows confirmation dialog with method name
Toast notifications appear for status changes
skeleton_shimmer: Dashboard skeleton shows during loading (stats cards, charts)
Products skeleton shows product card grid (9 cards)
Sales skeleton shows table with 8 rows
Skeletons visible when localStorage is cleared (cache invalidated)

critical_code_review_comments: PaymentMethods.js is well-structured with proper React Query hooks (usePaymentMethods, useCreatePaymentMethod, useUpdatePaymentMethod, useDeletePaymentMethod)
Skeleton components properly use Tailwind CSS with shimmer animation
Route protection correctly implemented with RoleProtectedRoute in App.js
Layout.js correctly filters menu items based on user role
Form validation present for required fields (code, name)
Preview component updates in real-time as form data changes
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing payment methods
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two features tested: 1) Skeleton shimmer components work on Dashboard, Products, Sales, Supplies pages - visible during initial load when cache is cleared. Animation uses @keyframes shimmer in index.css. 2) Payment Methods admin page (/payment-methods) fully functional with CRUD operations. Admin-only access enforced via RoleProtectedRoute. 5 payment methods exist: cash, orange_money, card, check, mtn_money. Each can have required_fields with name, label, type, placeholder, maxLength, required properties.
